spec.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import re,collections,json,os
p='inputs/chall/Carmine-Falcone.raw'; out=os.environ['OUT']; rg=re.compile(rb'((?:\xcf\x25){1,64})(..)'); c=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter); ex=[]; off=0; tail=b''
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 while True:
  b=f.read(32<<20)
  if not b: break
  x=tail+b; base=off-len(tail)
  for m in rg.finditer(x):
   pos=len(m.group(1))//2; cp=int.from_bytes(m.group(2),'little')
   if 0x20<=cp<=0x7e:
    ch=chr(cp); c[pos][ch]+=1
    if len(ex)<1000: ex.append([base+m.start(),pos,ch])
  off+=len(b); tail=x[-132:]
r={'position_counts':{str(k):dict(v) for k,v in sorted(c.items())},'examples':ex}
open(out+'/residue_all.json','w').write(json.dumps(r,indent=2)); print(json.dumps(r['position_counts'],indent=2))
PY
